title: New Criteria for Composition Operators into Weighted Harmonic Bloch Spaces
content:
In this paper, we obtain new criteria for the norm and the essential norm of composition
operators acting from the space $\mathcal{H}^{\infty}$ of bounded harmonic mappings into
weighted harmonic Bloch spaces $\mathcal{B}^{\alpha}_H$, $0< \alpha< \infty$, on the unit disk.
These criteria are expressed in terms of the asymptotic behavior of the sequence
$\{\|C_{\psi}q_k\|_{\mathcal{B}^{\alpha}_H}\}_{k\ge0}$ and of a family
of M\"obius-invariant test functions, yielding symbol-based characterizations of boundedness and of compactness, and hence of the essential norm for 
$C_{\psi}:\mathcal{H}^{\infty} \to \mathcal{B}^{\alpha}_H$.
